MWI.note: Only Vision 2063 is named, a development plan, not a national digital strategy.

facts.fact: Leyman Publications reports Malawi deposited its instrument of ratification of the African Telecommunications Union Constitution and Convention in Nairobi on 12 June 2025.

Leyman Publications reports Malawi moved from observer to full member of the African Telecommunications Union on depositing its instrument of ratification, MACRA saying this gives it full participation rights including election to the Administrative Council.
